execution.summary: cloudflare-dns now owns normalized domain-suffix mappings and a domain-keyed ResolveToken entry. Create/Share assign distinct or shared Vault secret_refs; longest suffix wins; non-suffix names miss; duplicate normalized suffixes are rejected. Callers pass the involved domain plus an optional per-call fallback Token. A mapping hit redeems that mapping's Vault material and never uses the fallback; a miss returns the caller-provided fallback; a miss with no fallback fails as that domain having no available Token. Lists, status, errors, UI, audit, and IssuedToken JSON expose only suffixes and metadata. Existing DNS broker tests remain.

findings: P1: plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:266 | root cause: DeleteMapping only unmaps memory and leaves the suffix-keyed Vault enroll plus its committed operation identity intact, so a later CreateMapping of the same normalized suffix either replays that committed enroll or cannot enroll the deterministic secret_ref | refs: plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:29, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:67, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:525, testing/integration/cloudflare-dns/cloudflare_test.go:781, testing/integration/cloudflare-dns/mapping_test.go:157 | impact: after delete (or rename away from a created suffix), recreating that suffix resurrects the old Vault material when the client reuses the create operation key, or fails/pends on a new key because the hashed secret_ref still exists; new Token bytes are discarded | minimal fix: retire or rebind the suffix-owned Vault identity and stop treating a pre-delete mapping-create commit as a live mapping

P2[blocking]: plugins/cloudflare-dns/service.go:729 | root cause: Cancel nils service.mappings while in-flight Create/Share/Rename/Rotate writers still assign into that map under mu without a live/nil guard | refs: plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:145, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:192, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:474, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:519 | impact: generation revoke or Close during a mapping mutation panics instead of failing closed with ErrRevoked, and can prevent drain | minimal fix: swap in an empty map or reject writes when the service is unlive/mappings is unset under the same lock

execution.summary: Fixed the two T-map-resolve review findings in cloudflare-dns. Delete and rename-away now retire the vacated suffix epoch so a later CreateMapping of that name uses a new operation identity and a new suffix-owned Vault secret_ref; a pre-delete mapping-create commit is no longer restored as a live mapping. Same-key retry of a still-live create remains exactly-once. Cancel now swaps in empty mapping/retired maps instead of nilling them, and every mapping writer checks live/nil under the same lock and fails closed with ErrRevoked.

entries.reason: Repair added this test to lock the Cancel/live-map fail-closed path inside the current T-map-resolve plugin scope.

execution.summary: Repaired T-map-resolve delivery after catalog Load was wired into Controller.Activate. The integration fakeVault now returns ErrMappingCatalogNotFound for a missing suffix-owned catalog ref, matching the dedicated first-boot not-found contract instead of leaking raw missing token into Activate. Added TestCloudflareRPCActivateLoadsEmptyCatalogAndResolves so first-boot Activate can create a mapping, resolve the longest suffix without using fallback, return the caller fallback on a miss, and fail as that domain having no available Token when neither mapping nor fallback is present.
